migrate_imports_dry_run: run a dry run to preview import path replacements in a Python or YAML file
migrate_imports_execute_file: execute import path migration on a single Python file using the migrate_imports CLI tool
migrate_imports_execute_directory: recursively migrate import paths across all Python and YAML files in a directory
migrate_imports_replace_strings: replace old fairchem import paths with new ones in a given file using the mapping dictionary
migrate_imports_cli_usage: run the migrate_imports CLI with --input and --execute flags to update import paths in code
